sloka: हिमवान् मन्दरो मेरुस्त्रैलोक्यं वा सहामरैः ।शक्यं भुजाभ्यामुद्धर्तु न सङ्ख्ये भरतानुजः ।। ६.५९.१११ ।।।।
transliteration: himavān mandaro merustrailokyaṁ vā sahāmaraiḥ ।śakyaṁ bhujābhyāmuddhartu na saṅkhye bharatānujaḥ ।। 6.59.111 ।।।।

translations.english: Lakshmana the eminent hero of Raghu's was badly hurt by the javelin and was burning in pain. King Ravana caught him who was losing consciousness, violently and held him by his shoulders.
